Invoice: One row per customer purchase (order header).
InvoiceLine: One row per track purchased within an invoice (order line).
Invoice.Total: Total amount of the invoice in dollars (sum of its lines).
Invoice.InvoiceDate: Text timestamp 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss'; use strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) for the year.
Invoice.BillingCountry: Country the invoice was billed to (can differ from Customer.Country).
InvoiceLine.UnitPrice: Price per unit of the track at time of sale.
InvoiceLine.Quantity: Number of units purchased on this line. Line revenue = UnitPrice * Quantity.
Track.Milliseconds: Track length in milliseconds (60000 ms = 1 minute).
Track.UnitPrice: Current list price of the track in dollars.
Track.Composer: Composer credits as free text; often NULL.
Track.AlbumId: Album the track belongs to; can be NULL for singles.
Customer.SupportRepId: EmployeeId of the sales support agent assigned to this customer.
Employee.ReportsTo: EmployeeId of this employee's manager; NULL for the top manager.
Playlist: Named playlist; names are not unique (two playlists are called 'Music').
PlaylistTrack: Link table: which tracks belong to which playlist.
Album: Album released by exactly one artist; contains tracks.
Genre.Name: Genre label such as Rock, Jazz, Metal.
MediaType.Name: File format of a track, e.g. 'MPEG audio file'.
